name: omv-mcp
description: Manage an OpenMediaVault NAS over SSH.
long_description:
Gives Claude access to an OpenMediaVault NAS through OMV's own RPC layer -- the same one the web interface uses -- over an ordinary SSH connection. Inspect disks, filesystems, shared folders, users and S.M.A.R.T. health; restart services; apply configuration changes; run background jobs and read their output.

Nothing is installed on the NAS and no extra port is opened. Authentication is your existing SSH key.

Rather than a fixed list of narrow tools, the extension discovers the services and methods your particular installation offers at runtime, so OMV plugins you install later work straight away.

Start with **Read-only mode** enabled to explore safely.

ssh_host.title: NAS hostname or IP address
ssh_host.description: For example 192.168.1.100, or a host name from your ~/.ssh/config.

ssh_user.title: SSH username
ssh_user.description: The account used to log in to the NAS. OpenMediaVault blocks root over SSH by default -- either enable it under Services / SSH, or use your own account and switch on 'Run commands with sudo' below.

ssh_port.title: SSH port
ssh_port.description: Change this only if your NAS does not use the standard port.

ssh_key.title: SSH private key
ssh_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to use your ssh-agent and ~/.ssh/config, which is usually what you want. Password logins are not supported: the connection runs with BatchMode enabled, so it can never stop to prompt you.

rpc_user.title: OpenMediaVault user
rpc_user.description: The OMV account the RPC call runs as. This is the web interface login, not the SSH user.

use_sudo.title: Run commands with sudo
use_sudo.description: Switch this on when the SSH user above is not root. That account must be in the sudo group.

readonly.title: Read-only mode
readonly.description: Refuses anything that does not look like a read operation, and disables shell access. Recommended while you get a feel for what the extension does. Turn it off when you want Claude to actually change settings.

allow_shell.title: Allow arbitrary shell commands
allow_shell.description: Adds a tool that runs any shell command on the NAS, as the SSH user. Useful for logs, docker and package state -- but it is unrestricted, so leave it off unless you need it.

timeout.title: Command timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long a single command may take before it is aborted. Long jobs should use the background task tool instead of a high value here.

tools.name: omv_connection_info
tools.description: Show the active configuration and test connectivity to the NAS

tools.name: omv_list_services
tools.description: List all OpenMediaVault RPC services, including those added by plugins

tools.name: omv_list_methods
tools.description: List the methods of one RPC service

tools.name: omv_wait_for_task
tools.description: Collect the output of a background job started by omv_call

tools.name: omv_shell
tools.description: Run an arbitrary shell command on the NAS
